content.title: Knicks vs. Hornets: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/26/26)
content.text: The New York Knicks (48–25) visit the Charlotte Hornets (38–34) tonight at the Spectrum Center, riding a seven-game winning streak. New York enters the night in third place in the Eastern Conference, just half a game out of second and 4.5 games behind the first-place Detroit Pistons. Charlotte, currently ninth in the East, is headed for a play-in berth. If the Hornets climb to seventh or eighth and advance, a first-round matchup with the Knicks is very much in play — if New York secures the No. 2 seed. Regardless of postseason scenarios, both teams are among the hottest in the league. The Hornets bring a four-game winning streak into tonight, while the Knicks have been even hotter. New York is coming off a 121–116 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Tuesday, powered by its starting unit. Jalen Brunson led the way with 32 points on 11-of-19 shooting. OG Anunoby and Karl-Anthony Towns added 21 points apiece, with Towns also pulling down 14 rebounds. The Knicks shot an efficient 52% from the field and held off a Pelicans team that had won six of its previous nine. Charlotte has been just as impressive, winning four straight and six of its last seven. The Hornets are coming off a dominant 134–90 blowout of the Sacramento Kings on Tuesday, in which they knocked down 26 three-pointers — tying a franchise record. Over their last four games, they’re averaging 131.0 points per game. Coby White, acquired at the trade deadline, erupted for 27 points in just 18 minutes, going 6-of-8 from beyond the arc. LaMelo Ball added 20 points, while Moussa Diabate contributed a 17-point, 11-rebound double-double. Expect a tight one. Charlotte has the edge tonight with an offense that has been unstoppable at home. Prediction: Charlotte Hornets 118, New York Knicks 115 Injury Report New York Knicks Miles McBride — Out (Pelvis) Landry Shamet — Out (Knee) Kevin McCullar Jr. — Questionable (Quadriceps) Charlotte Hornets Tidjane Salaun — Out (Calf) Pat Connaughton — Questionable (Illness) How to Watch Knicks vs. Hornets Tip-off for tonight’s Knicks vs. Hornets game is set for 7:00 PM Eastern at Spectrum Center in Charlotte, North Carolina.
